game.title: Arcade
game.subtitle: Provably fair mini-games on virtual credits.
game.riskNotice: These are gambling-style games played with virtual NX credits only. Never connect real funds to them: real-money betting needs a gambling licence, age/KYC checks and an audited RNG. Games are designed to lose money over time — the house edge is 3%.
game.fairnessExplain: Each round is derived from a server seed (committed in advance as a hash), your client seed and a nonce. After you rotate the seed you can re-hash the revealed server seed and confirm it matches the commitment.
game.verifyHint: SHA-256 of this seed must equal the previous commitment. It covered {{rounds}} round(s).
game.fairnessLimitation: Honest limitation: the seed is generated in your own browser here, so it proves the UI didn't change the result mid-round — it is not equivalent to a licensed operator's independently audited RNG.

predict.title: Price prediction
predict.teaser: Call the next candle — up or down
predict.subtitle: Settled on live market prices
predict.riskNotice: Short-term up/down betting on virtual credits. Real-money binary options are a regulated derivative and are banned for retail traders in the UK and EU — do not connect real funds.

wallet.custodyNotice: Read-only. This app has no deposit address and never asks you to send crypto anywhere. Any bot that asks you to transfer funds to it should be treated as a scam.
wallet.resetDesc: Reset your virtual balance, positions, plans and history back to the starting state.
wallet.connectSubtitle: You keep your keys. This app never sees them.
wallet.wcDesc: MetaMask, Trust, Rainbow… via QR or deep link
wallet.injectedDesc: Use the wallet injected into this browser
wallet.createLocalDesc: New 12-word wallet, encrypted on this device
wallet.unlockLocalDesc: Enter your password to sign transactions
wallet.localRisk: The in-app wallet stores an encrypted key inside a Telegram WebView — no secure enclave, no hardware isolation. It is fine for small amounts, but anything you would be upset to lose belongs in MetaMask/Trust via WalletConnect, or on a hardware wallet.
wallet.noWcProject: Set VITE_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID in your .env to enable WalletConnect. Get a free project ID at cloud.reown.com.
wallet.backupWarning: Write these 12 words down on paper, in order, and store them offline. Anyone with this phrase owns your funds forever. Nobody — not us, not Telegram — can recover it if you lose it. Never type it into any website or send it to anyone.
wallet.passwordDesc: This password encrypts your key on this device. It is not recoverable — if you forget it you will need your seed phrase.
wallet.unlockDesc: Your key is decrypted in memory only and cleared when you lock.
wallet.ackText: I understand that I alone control this wallet, that my seed phrase is the only way to recover it, and that nobody can restore my funds if I lose it.
wallet.forgetWarning: This deletes the encrypted key from this device. Without your seed phrase the funds are gone forever.

swap.subtitle: Real on-chain swaps via {{dex}}
swap.nonCustodialNotice: Non-custodial: you sign every transaction from your own wallet and it broadcasts directly to the blockchain. This app takes no fee, holds no funds and has no address in the flow.
swap.slippageHelp: Your swap reverts if the price moves against you by more than this. Too low and it fails on volatile pairs; too high and you accept a worse fill.
swap.slippageHigh: Above 3% you are very exposed to sandwich attacks. Only raise this for illiquid tokens.
swap.highImpact: High price impact — this pool is thin and you will lose a lot of value on this trade. Consider a smaller amount.
swap.reviewNotice: Your wallet will ask you to sign. Check the amounts there too — what your wallet shows is what actually executes.
swap.verifyContracts: Always verify token contract addresses independently. Fake tokens with real names are the most common way people get drained.

about.title: About us
about.tagline: Trade & technology for a new economy
about.body1: FBT iran is a commercial trading company based in Khomeyni Shahr, Isfahan. Our roots are in conventional commerce, and our direction is firmly toward the new digital economy — where value moves without intermediaries and markets stay open around the clock.
about.body2: We built this exchange because we believe access to global markets shouldn't depend on where you happen to live, which bank will take you, or who is willing to hold your money. A decentralized exchange removes those gatekeepers: you connect your own wallet, you trade, and the assets never leave your control.
about.body3: We are a small team that prefers shipping honest software over marketing promises. The app tells you exactly what it does, what it charges, and what it cannot protect you from. We would rather you understand the risk than be pleasantly surprised by it later.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.body: Fees are shown before you sign, every transaction is verifiable on-chain, and our contract is public.

innovation.title: New economy
innovation.body: We treat blockchain as real financial infrastructure, not a trend to chase.

access.title: Open access
access.body: No account, no approval, no minimum balance. A wallet is all you need.

security.title: Self-custody
security.body: We hold nothing. There is no company wallet for your funds to sit in and no withdrawal queue.

about.addressValue: Isfahan, Khomeyni Shahr, Shahid Beheshti Blvd., next to District 4 Municipality
about.custodyBody: This is a non-custodial exchange. Trades execute directly between your wallet and the blockchain. FBT iran has no access to your assets, cannot freeze or reverse a transaction, and cannot recover a lost seed phrase.
about.riskDisclosure: Trading crypto assets carries substantial risk, including total loss of capital. Prices are volatile and on-chain transactions are irreversible. Nothing in this app is financial advice. Only trade what you can afford to lose, and make sure you understand your local regulations.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Questions, partnership enquiries or a bug to report — reach us directly on Telegram.
contact.supportBody: We answer Telegram messages during Iranian business hours, usually within one working day. When reporting a problem with a trade, include the transaction hash — it lets us see exactly what happened on-chain.
contact.scamWarning: We will never DM you first, never ask for your seed phrase or wallet password, and never ask you to send crypto to an address for any reason. Anyone doing so while claiming to be FBT is impersonating us. Our only official contact is the Telegram account shown above.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using FBT Swap you agree to these terms. Please read them — they describe real limits on what this app can do for you, and what happens if something goes wrong.

nature.title: What this app is
nature.body: FBT Swap is a non-custodial interface to decentralized exchanges on BNB Smart Chain. It is software that helps you build and sign your own blockchain transactions. It is not a bank, broker, exchange, or money transmitter, and it does not hold or manage anyone's assets.

noCustody.title: We never hold your funds
noCustody.body: Your assets stay in your own wallet at all times. We have no deposit address, no access to your private keys or seed phrase, and no ability to move, freeze, reverse or recover your funds — including if you are hacked, scammed, or lose your seed phrase. Nobody at FBT iran can restore a lost wallet.

fees.title: Platform fee
fees.body: A 0.5% fee is taken from the input amount of each swap and paid to FBT iran. It is shown in the app before you confirm, and it is charged on-chain in the same transaction. Network gas fees are separate and go to blockchain validators, not to us.

risk.title: You accept the risk
risk.body: Crypto assets are extremely volatile and you can lose everything. Blockchain transactions are irreversible — a wrong address or wrong network means permanent loss. Smart contracts can contain bugs. Tokens can be worthless, fraudulent, or designed so you cannot sell them. Prices shown are estimates and the amount you receive may differ.

noAdvice.title: Not financial advice
noAdvice.body: Nothing in this app is investment, financial, legal or tax advice. Prices, charts, rankings and any simulated features are for information only. You are solely responsible for your decisions and for any tax you owe.

eligibility.title: Who may use it
eligibility.body: You must be of legal age where you live and legally permitted to use decentralized finance services there. Crypto rules differ sharply between countries and some restrict or prohibit this entirely. Confirming that you are allowed to use this app is your responsibility, not ours.

prohibited.title: Prohibited use
prohibited.body: Do not use FBT Swap for money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions evasion, fraud, market manipulation, or any illegal activity. Do not attempt to attack, reverse engineer for exploitation, or disrupt the service or its users.

thirdParty.title: Third-party services
thirdParty.body: Swaps route through third-party protocols such as the KyberSwap aggregator and PancakeSwap, and market data comes from providers like CoinGecko. Wallet connections use WalletConnect. We do not control these services and are not responsible for their failures, downtime, pricing or losses arising from them.

availability.title: No guarantee of service
availability.body: The app is provided 'as is' with no warranty of any kind. We may change, suspend or discontinue any part of it at any time, without notice. We do not promise it will be available, error-free, or that quotes will always be accurate.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, FBT iran and its team are not liable for any loss of funds, profits, or data arising from your use of this app — including losses from smart-contract bugs, third-party protocols, price movements, network failures, phishing, or your own mistakes.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms as the app evolves. Continuing to use FBT Swap after an update means you accept the revised terms. Significant changes will be noted in the app.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Short version: FBT Swap collects almost nothing. There is no signup, no email, no phone number, and no identity verification. Most of your data never leaves your device.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: If you enable cloud sync, we store your display preferences — theme, accent colour, chosen username and language — against an anonymous ID. That anonymous ID is generated by Firebase and is not linked to your name, email or phone number.

notCollect.title: What we never collect
notCollect.body: We never collect or transmit your seed phrase, private keys, wallet password or two-factor secret. Those are encrypted on your own device and never sent anywhere. We cannot read them, and neither can anyone who breaches our systems — because they are not in our systems.

onchain.title: Blockchain data is public
onchain.body: Every swap you make is recorded permanently on the public blockchain, including your wallet address and amounts. This is inherent to how blockchains work, is visible to everyone, and is not something we or anyone else can delete. Treat your wallet address as public information.

thirdPartyData.title: Third parties you touch
thirdPartyData.body: Using the app sends requests to services we do not control: CoinGecko and GeckoTerminal for prices, the KyberSwap aggregator for routing, public BSC RPC nodes for balances, and WalletConnect when you connect a wallet. These services see your IP address and can set their own policies. Please read theirs.

storage.title: On-device storage
storage.body: Your balances, settings, encrypted wallet and app history are stored in your device's local storage. Clearing your browser or app data deletes them permanently. If you delete an in-app wallet without saving its seed phrase, the funds are unrecoverable.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: If Firebase Analytics is enabled in a build, we may see aggregate usage such as which screens are opened. This is not tied to your wallet address or your identity, and we do not sell data to anyone.

rights.title: Your control
rights.body: You can wipe every piece of local data at any time from Settings, or by uninstalling the app. To remove synced preferences, disable cloud sync and contact us. Because we hold no identity data, there is nothing else to request or delete.

contact.title: Questions
contact.body: Reach us on Telegram at @Shiravi4333, or at the FBT iran office in Khomeyni Shahr, Isfahan. We will never message you first and will never ask for your seed phrase.

perp.title: Perpetuals
perp.subtitle: Leveraged futures on live index prices.
perp.riskNotice: Leverage multiplies losses as fast as gains. At 100x a 1% move against you liquidates the entire position. Most retail perp traders lose money. Never use leverage with funds you need.
perp.indexNote: Spot index from our market feed, shown for reference. Actual perp marks and funding rates are set by the venue you trade on.
perp.honestTitle: Why FBT doesn't run its own perp engine
perp.honestBody: A perpetual exchange needs an on-chain matching engine, oracle feeds, a liquidation keeper network, an insurance fund and market makers. PancakeSwap doesn't build this in-house either — their perp product is powered by ApolloX. Shipping a fake perp screen would be worse than shipping none, because you'd think your leveraged position was real. So we show live prices and route you to venues that actually run the infrastructure.

gmx.desc: Established decentralized perp DEX with a shared liquidity pool.

perp.thirdPartyNotice: These are independent third-party protocols. FBT iran is not the counterparty, does not control them, earns nothing from them, and cannot help recover losses. Verify every URL yourself — perp venues are a common phishing target.
perp.tryPredictSub: Try up/down prediction on virtual credits

farm.title: Farm
farm.subtitle: Earn yield by providing liquidity.
farm.whatBody: You deposit two tokens into a liquidity pool and receive LP tokens representing your share. Traders swapping through that pool pay fees, which accrue to you. Staking the LP tokens in a farm adds a second reward stream on top.
farm.ilBody: If the two tokens change price relative to each other, you end up with more of the one that fell and less of the one that rose. You can finish worse off than if you had simply held them, even after collecting fees. The wider the price gap moves, the worse it gets. Stablecoin pairs barely suffer from this; volatile pairs suffer a lot.
farm.aprNote: APR figures are indicative ranges, not promises. Real yield changes constantly with trading volume, emissions and how much liquidity is in the pool. Always check the live rate before depositing.
farm.custodyNotice: These farms are operated by PancakeSwap, not by FBT. You deposit directly from your own wallet into their audited contracts — we never touch your funds and take no cut of your yield.

signals.title: AI Signals
signals.subtitle: Technical analysis across the market, updated live.
signals.coneExplain: This is a volatility range, not a forecast. If {{d}}-day price movement continues at its recent pace, roughly {{p}}% of outcomes fall inside this band. It says nothing about direction.
signals.disclaimer: These are classical technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger, moving averages) computed on real price history — the same maths behind most 'AI signal' products. They summarise what the chart is doing; they cannot predict the future. Markets are close to random at short horizons. Never trade purely on a score.

stocks.title: Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Tokenized real-world assets.
stocks.rwaBody: RWA protocols bring treasury bills, credit and commodities onto the blockchain. Their governance tokens trade like any other crypto asset and you can swap them here.
stocks.rwaNote: These are the tokens of protocols building tokenization infrastructure. They are not shares in those companies and they do not track equity prices.
stocks.noTokens: No RWA tokens in the current market data
stocks.honestTitle: Why you can't buy Apple stock here
stocks.honestBody: A token representing Apple stock is a security. Issuing one requires a licensed issuer holding the real shares in custody, a prospectus in most countries, and a broker-dealer licence to distribute it. PancakeSwap doesn't offer this either. Building it is a licensing project, not a coding one — so instead we point you at issuers who already hold those licences.

ondo.name: Ondo Finance
ondo.desc: Tokenized US treasuries and short-term bonds

stocks.kycNotice: These issuers require identity verification and may not accept users from every country. FBT iran has no affiliation with them, earns nothing from them, and cannot help with their onboarding.
stocks.riskNotice: Tokenized assets carry both market risk and issuer risk — if the issuer fails or is shut down, the token may not be redeemable for the underlying asset. Verify who holds the collateral before buying.
